title: Refract behavioural-baseline manifest
description: .claude/baselines/<sha>/manifest.json — the stored behaviour a change is compared against (proposal §7). `.claude/baselines/main/manifest.json` is the committed registry: every entry names the engine that produces it, the command that re-produces it at any sha, the paths whose change puts it in scope, and where its artifact lives. `.claude/baselines/<sha>/` is a local capture made at that sha (run phase P5, before the implementer edits) and is never committed. Written by .claude/scripts/baseline-capture.sh, read by behavior-diff.py (gate G14) and perf-compare.py (gate G4). Keywords are the subset .claude/scripts/refract_records.py validates.

sha.description: The commit this capture was made at, or `main` for the rolling registry.

id.description: Stable entry id. An acceptance criterion declares a difference by naming it in `changes_baseline` (`<id>` or `<id>/<case>`).

engine.description: <pack>/<skill> that produces the artifact: testing/characterize, backend/api-snapshot, frontend/visual-check, frontend/lighthouse-ci, performance/profile-endpoint, database/schema-diff, ai-engineering/eval-run, migration/parity-test-generate, or `project` for a hand-registered command.

command.description: Re-produces the behaviour at the current checkout, from the repo root, under /bin/bash. compare=golden|file: writes its artifact into "$REFRACT_BASELINE_OUT". compare=exit: exit 0 means the behaviour matches the engine's own committed baseline. compare=perf: prints ONE measurement per run (a number, or a line perf-compare.py parses).

scope_paths.description: Globs (fnmatch; ** crosses directories) over repo paths. A change touching any of them puts the entry in scope.

harness_paths.description: Files the command needs that may not exist at an older sha (the characterization harness, its inputs). Overlaid from HEAD when the base side is re-captured in a worktree.

artifact_path.description: Repo-relative path of the stored artifact (a golden directory, a snapshot file, a samples file). For compare=exit, the engine's own committed baseline it checks against.

tolerance.description: The parity-test-generate tolerance taxonomy (JSONPath-lite: $.a.b, $.items[*].c). null = exact comparison of the whole artifact.

cadence.description: pr = cheap: refreshed on every merge to main and re-run at Stop when in scope. nightly = visual, perf, load: refreshed nightly, compared in CI.

bench.description: Benchmark name to select when the command prints several (go test -bench, JMH, pytest-benchmark).

nondeterministic.description: Quarantine (proposal §7 rule 3): the entry differed across 3 identical runs at capture. Its diffs are reported, never enforced, until the expiry; an expired quarantine is a FAIL. Never cleared by re-baselining.
